categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four segments: optical disc products (including DVD, CD, VCD, Blu-ray), cultural and creative dining industries (including historical building revitalization and multi-brand restaurant chains), renewable energy (solar power plant development and management), and elderly care services (community-based day care and long-term care technology).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing processes for optical discs including plastic injection molding, sputtering of reflective layers, UV curing, and printing. It holds certifications such as ISO 9001 and ISO 45001 for quality and occupational safety. In renewable energy, it integrates solar power system engineering and plant operation. In elderly care, it develops proprietary day care operation systems and family apps to enhance service quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include media content producers, software and multimedia companies, cultural and creative industry participants, public and private entities for solar power projects, and elderly individuals requiring long-term care. Major markets are Taiwan, Japan, and other Asian regions, with some presence in the Americas and Australia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan, covering northern, central, southern, and eastern regions for solar projects. It also serves international markets including Japan, the Americas, and Asia. Cultural and creative projects are focused in Taipei and surrounding areas.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments: manufacturing optical discs, managing cultural and dining venues, developing and operating solar power plants, and providing elderly care services. It integrates upstream materials from suppliers but focuses on production, service delivery, and end-customer engagement.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include maintaining and expanding optical disc product lines with quality and cost control, developing cultural and creative industries with innovative dining concepts, expanding renewable energy capacity and operational efficiency, and advancing elderly care services with technology integration. R&D focuses on green innovation, digital media solutions, and care technology platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales of optical discs, service fees from cultural and dining operations, electricity sales and management fees from solar power plants, and fees for elderly care services. The company also engages in licensing and turnkey project solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the optical disc industry, the company is one of the few remaining players with high-quality production and Blu-ray certification, benefiting from competitors exiting the market. In cultural and creative sectors, it leverages unique historical assets and multi-brand dining to differentiate. In renewable energy, it ranks among Taiwan's top ten public solar power plant operators with strong management capabilities. In elderly care, it adopts innovative care models and technology to compete.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$1.25 billion with a net profit of NT$101 million in the latest fiscal year. It has shown revenue growth of over 10% year-on-year, with steady increases in assets and equity. Investments include acquisitions to expand elderly care and renewable energy businesses, supporting a diversified growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes total solution services in optical discs with high-quality, timely delivery, and anti-piracy technology. It differentiates cultural and dining offerings through historical building revitalization and creative multi-brand concepts. Renewable energy services focus on integrated project development and long-term stable returns. Elderly care services highlight community-based, technology-enhanced, and personalized care models promoting independence.
